prompt.text:
Implement an authenticated in-memory card update service in package `solution` using only the standard library.

Export:

```go
type Card struct {
    ID    int    `json:"id"`
    Board string `json:"board"`
    Name  string `json:"name"`
    Slug  string `json:"slug"`
    Title string `json:"title"`
}

type CardService struct { /* unexported fields */ }

var ErrUnauthorized error
var ErrInvalidID error
var ErrBadBody error
var ErrNotFound error

func NewCardService(cards []Card, access map[string][]string, searchEnabled, eventsEnabled bool) *CardService
func (s *CardService) UpdateCard(actor, board string, id int, body []byte) (Card, error)
func (s *CardService) SearchCopy() map[int]Card
func (s *CardService) EventsCopy() []Card
```

`access` maps actors to boards. The constructor must copy all input collections. Later duplicate card IDs replace earlier ones.

`UpdateCard` returns `ErrUnauthorized` when actor or board is empty or access is absent, `ErrInvalidID` for IDs below 1, and `ErrNotFound` unless the card exists on the requested board. The JSON body may contain any nonempty subset of `name`, `slug`, and `title`; reject unknown fields, malformed JSON, trailing JSON, `null`, `{}`, and empty or whitespace-only values with `ErrBadBody`. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Failures must not mutate any state.

After a successful update, replace the stored card. If search is enabled, replace its search entry. If events are enabled, append the updated card. `SearchCopy` and `EventsCopy` return independent snapshots and return non-nil empty collections for nil receivers.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
